headline: Igor Jesus nets beauty against Cheslea
description: Igor Jesus scores a goal-of-the-year contender for Nottingham Forest in a 3-2 win over Chelsea.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Manchester United's Bruno Fernandes still eyeing way out
description: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes is still considering his options despite his contract extension. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Alonso urges Chelsea to 'stick together' amid run of three losses
description: Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso said his team should "stick together" after a 3-2 loss to Nottingham Forest on Friday made it three Premier League defeats in a row for the Stamford Bridge side.

headline: Moreno: Alonso must drop Fofana for Chelsea's benefit
description: The ESPN FC crew react to Nottingham Forest beating Chelsea 3-2 in the Premier League.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Chelsea, Tottenham eye move for Wolfsburg's Kumbedi
description: Both Chelsea and Tottenham are reportedly looking at Wolfsburg's Saël Kumbedi as a possible new signing. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Jesus stunner helps Forest dump Chelsea for another big home win
description: Chelsea slumped to a third-successive Premier League defeat as they went down 3-2 at Nottingham Forest on Friday to mount pressure on boss Xavi Alonso.
